description: Approved funding rounds, newest first, with optional filters and keyset pagination. Pass the returned next_cursor fields (after_date, after_id) to get the next page.

after_date.description: Cursor: announced date of the last row seen.

after_id.description: Cursor: id of the last row seen.

amount_min.description: Minimum disclosed amount in the announced currency.

category.description: Round category: equity, debt, fund (fund close), grant or ipo (initial public offering; amount is the offering size when disclosed).

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive. Matches the company's country.

name: list_funding_rounds
title: List funding rounds
